draft_role: Prepared from the completed private report and training code; root still performs final artifact/content/licensing review.

model_card.scope: one/two digit strings in a fixed 5x7 font, not handwriting or documents
limitations: Small generated tasks and fixed splits do not establish natural-image perception, speech recognition, general instruction following or broad multimodal reasoning.
Greedy generation and intervention scores are measured separately; successful loading on generated input is not accuracy evidence.
This is fixed-font one/two-digit reading, not handwriting or document OCR. CER is decoded text; raw-token exact match also rejects invalid specials.
Each digit-string family has three image positions; 30 test rows cover only 10 distinct strings. Test exact match is 2/30 and decoded CER is 40/57 despite EOS on every test output.

training.loss_probe: same deterministic batch before and after training
training.timing_scope: optimizer loop including logging, periodic local checkpoints and CUDA synchronization; excludes probes, evaluation and final file write

test.character_error_scope: decoded text; raw-token exact match rejects invalid special tokens counted separately

data.split_policy: digit-string family; all position variants stay in the same split

evaluation.scope: one/two digit strings in a fixed 5x7 font, not handwriting or documents

training_data.source: Generated one/two digit strings in a fixed 5×7 font, grouped by digit string
training_data.modifications: Program-generated controlled records; family-level split before training.

inference.method: Create one local fixed-font example with the existing course drawing function, then pass it to the downloaded model. Run from the project root with installed Python.
commands: python -c "from pathlib import Path; from scripts.prepare_ocr import draw_digits; p=Path('outputs/course-student/ocr-42.png'); p.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True); draw_digits('42').save(p)"
python scripts/infer_modal.py checkpoints/course/ocr/model.pt --image outputs/course-student/ocr-42.png --prompt "read digits" --tokens 5 --device cpu
inference.scope: One generated input is an operation example, not held-out accuracy evidence. The top-level automated manifest command supplies a colour/shape scene only for load/generation smoke checking, not OCR evaluation. No example image or original data is distributed in the weight package.

review.scope: Reviewed final full multimodal checkpoint hash, complete-run provenance and actual synthetic SFT/both-encoder initialization. Recomputed 2/30 exact match and decoded CER 40/57 over 10 held-out digit strings at three offsets. All test outputs end with EOS; blank-image accuracy is 0/30. Fixed-font limits, MIT notice and actual draw_digits image recipe checked. Public export still requires native reconstruction, anonymous pinned-file verification and actual CPU inference on the generated digit image.
